description: Checks an AI video edit job and shows its result when done. Use when the progress card refreshes a job started with start_video_edit. Not for AI clip jobs (use get_video_generation_status). Returns status, then the suggested metadata, chapters, or a playable result.

job_id.description: ID of the video edit job. Get it from start_video_edit or list_video_jobs.

name: get_video_edit_status
title: Get AI video edit status
